title: Repo Feature Manifest
description: Machine-readable, feature-centric description of a repo's user-facing capabilities. Consumed by the platform-e2e auto-generator to author Gherkin + steps + page objects. One file per repo at <repo>/FEATURES.yaml.

repo.description: Owning repo directory name, e.g. team-order.

owner.description: Optional team/handle responsible for these features.

id.description: Stable unique key across the polyrepo, form <domain>.<slug>, e.g. order.purchase-saga.

persona.description: Primary actor — drives which account the generator logs in as.

entry_route.description: Frontend path where the journey starts (may contain {param}).

services.description: All repos exercised — the set that must be running for this test.

login.description: Session to establish before the journey (null/guest = anonymous).

seed_tag.description: Marker in platform-e2e config/tags.py::TAG_PAYLOAD_MAP that seeds required state (e.g. needsListing).

seed.description: Gateway RPC ids used to set up state, form <service>.v1.<Method>.

exercised.description: RPC ids the feature drives — used for coverage mapping and API assertions.

key_elements.description: name -> platform-e2e semantic-locator string (role:/label:/text:/placeholder:/testid: or CSS). Feeds page-object generation.

acceptance.description: Gherkin-ready Given/When/Then lines the generator turns into a Scenario.

tags.description: Become pytest markers (register new ones in pyproject.toml).

status.description: planned = ready for auto-gen; automated = has a live scenario; manual = human-only; not-testable = excluded.
